response.sql: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), differences AS (SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, average_round - AVG(average_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS difference FROM circuit_averages) SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, difference FROM differences ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
